title: 9.10.2: Key Equations
originalText:
Key Equations

            Identity matrix for a \(2 × 2\) matrix	
            \({I}_{2}=[\begin{matrix}1&0\\0&1\end{matrix}]\)	

            Identity matrix for a \(3 × 3\) matrix	
            \({I}_{3}=[\begin{matrix}1&0&0\\0&1&0\\0&0&1\end{matrix}]\)	

            Multiplicative inverse of a \(2 × 2\) matrix	
            \({A}^{−1}=\frac{1}{ad−bc}[\begin{matrix}d&−b\\−c&a\end{matrix}], wheread−bc≠0\)
